messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xxs and p95 latency on /api/v1/generate (us-west).
incident-bot: metrics: 5xx_rate=4.3% p95=1.2s throughput down 28% | triggered paging to @maya
maya (oncall): ack, I'm on it. pulling traces and canary rollout metadata
maya (oncall): checked deploy-bot -> last rollout: wave-17 feature smart-batcher-v2 enabled on 10% canary pool
deploy-bot: rollout wave-17: smart-batcher-v2 -> canary pool (ids: c-120..c-135)
raj (infra): i'm seeing kernel fallback logs on canary nodes: many devices selecting generic kernel due to failed kernel probe
raj (infra): excerpt from node c-123:
```
[WARN] kernel-selector: probe failed: unsupported SIMD ext -> fallback to generic_kernel_v3
latency_ms: tail 580 -> 1200
```
paul (runtime): smart-batcher-v2 changes small-batch padding + batching window tweaks. if kernel fallback happens, batching degenerates -> tiny batches -> throughput collapse
sre-lead: this is a classic interaction: runtime changes + kernel fallback = tail latency + lost throughput. need immediate rollback path and kill-switch.
maya (oncall): action plan: 1) flip kill-switch to stop rollout traffic to canary 2) disable smart-batcher-v2 on canary 3) route traffic away from affected nodes 4) notify CS
maya (oncall): running: `redwood-cli feature disable smart-batcher-v2 --selector=canary-wave-17`
deploy-bot: command accepted. feature smart-batcher-v2 disabled on canary-wave-17
maya (oncall): flipping kill-switch: `prodctl route set-policy /api/v1/generate prefer=fallback-nodes` -> applied
raj (infra): starting drain of nodes c-120..c-135 from serving pool, moving warm KV caches to fallback pool
paul (runtime): temporarily forcing kernel pin to legacy optimized kernel on fallback pool: `runtime-tool pin-kernel --kernel=opt_kernel_v2 --nodes=fallback-*`
cs-ops: FYI: initial customer impact: a handful of enterprise customers saw 502/504s and elevated latencies in US-WEST. CS on standby, drafting communication.
maya (oncall): monitoring now: p95 dropping -> 430ms, 5xx back to 0.6%, throughput back to 92% of baseline
sre-lead: good. keep nodes drained until postmortem. we'll roll a rollback for wave-17 and coordinate a clean re-rollout after kernel probe fix.
paul (runtime): I'm opening a patch to make smart-batcher resilient to kernel fallback (graceful mode) and to avoid tiny-batch collapse
maya (oncall): handing off to raj and paul for post-deploy remediation and postmortem. i'm unpausing alerts for follow-up checks in 24h.
maya (oncall): @cs-ops please publish interim customer note: "we observed degraded performance during a partial rollout; we've reverted the change and traffic returned to normal. Full postmortem forthcoming."
cs-ops: will do. draft ready, sending to legal and support for approval.
sre-lead: escalation closed for now, remain on-call for any regressions. postmortem meeting scheduled: tomorrow 10:00 PT. Tags: root_cause=kernel_probe+batcher_interaction mitigation=kill-switch+rollback
deploy-bot: rollout wave-17 marked halted and rolled back by operator maya
maya (oncall): thanks all. leaving thread for handoff.
